whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Austaara - Fine Dine & Cafe,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 3.9★ reviews with 440+ visitors in Kidwaipuri, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu browsing.

Maine aapke fine dine cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu, aur ambiance gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/austaara

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Austaara Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke fine dine cafe (Austaara) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

*(If checked)* Great! We tailored it specifically with a digital menu, direct WhatsApp table booking, and a showcase of your dining ambiance in Kidwaipuri, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? 

*(If not checked)* No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback. 

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
